apps.localizedDescription: 基于 React Native (Expo) 构建的轻量级第三方知乎客户端，无广告，支持多账号切换、游客模式、全局主题色自定义与深色模式，可查看热榜、推荐、回答、文章、想法与评论区，并支持从 GitHub Releases 自动更新。

versions.localizedDescription:
auto release by GitHub Actions

下面看起来好乱我人工写一下吧...
- ios 个人主页的回答/文章可以查看了，吧
- 常规问题修复
- 还有一大批代码方向切入做的优化，主要是
  - 动画换写法（更新后很多地方应该会稍微不那么卡卡的了）
  - 各种弹窗归类，颜色去掉散乱的硬编码做集中配置（之后会考虑多调几个主题看看）
  - 基础的代码检查与修复，补充一些案例、测试和文档
  - 不过这种改法也可能会引入许多新的问题喵喵喵

## What's Changed
* fix: 同步作者关注状态与提示 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/45
* fix(ios): avoid duplicate cookies in signed API requests by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/46
* fix: 修复用户主页、关注状态与账号会话问题 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/47
* fix(comments): confirm copy from action sheet by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/49
* refactor(ui): unify dialogs and bottom sheets by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/50
* fix: 完善问题详情页回答列表与类型安全 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/51
* feat: centralize design tokens and add theme customization by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/54
* perf: smooth animations and gestures across app by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/55
* Fix rich content rendering and API fixture coverage by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/53


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/compare/v0.4.2...v0.5.0
